metadata.build_signature:
CC=clang
CPPFLAGS=-Iinclude -Isrc/internal -Isrc -D_GNU_SOURCE -Itools/preempt -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=700 -D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE
SHARED_CPPFLAGS=-Iinclude -Isrc/internal -Isrc -D_GNU_SOURCE -Itools/preempt -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=700 -D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE -DLLAM_BUILD_SHARED
CFLAGS=-std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -O2 -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer
LDLIBS=-pthread
OBJDIR=object
HOST_PLATFORM=darwin
UNAME_M=arm64
metadata.latency: send entry to receive return; one mixed phase per 16-message block, nearest-rank p99 of samples
metadata.throughput: validated request/ack exchanges per second; setup/join excluded
metadata.baseline: RELEASE_FAST, one P, AUTO preemption, lock-free normal queue, default burst=64; autotune off
metadata.limitations: SC finite protocol model, not full C11/ABI/lifetime proof; one-P performance; no ETH solver
metadata.sample_storage: lossless sorted [nanoseconds, count] histograms; no bucket approximation

postprocessing.operation: Lossless run-length encoding of the already sorted sample arrays; every value checked against original

native_service_witness.meaning: Observed native chain witness; not deterministic replay of every atomic model step
